15. Awwww P.S. Thanks for making it to the end of the dump. I really hope it made you smile. With the last few lines I would like to share some behind the scenes stuff. So if you don't feel like reading feel free to skip it. Some time ago I really wanted to start making games of my own. I've been a life long gamer and it seems such an awesome thing. So I started to learn on my own and managed to make a game and release it, then another, and then anther. Sure, at the start they were crap but I sat down for months and years and managed to start and finish a project. And now I'm working on my forth game and I've been getting so much positive feedback. The demo currently holds 100% positive review rating and playtesters are saying very nice things. I continue to work every day to make sure I complete it. It's a moral dilemma sim / trolley problem style game based on The Milgram Experiment. As always I use no AI to make it.
